grh_ad0d8941bae23c3c1abe.title: Barriers Down
paragraphs: A documentary-style adaptation of Kent Cooper's Barriers Down argues that monopolies and national controls over international news helped create prejudice and war. Dramatized examples show how distorted reporting encouraged nations to distrust one another, while the program traces Cooper's campaign for independent news exchange. Cooper appears in person at the end to call for a peace settlement guaranteeing worldwide freedom of the press, equal access to official information and communications, and protection against propaganda disguised as news.

grh_ad32849ca98c928debea.title: Dr Conlon Quack
paragraphs: A cancer patient reaches Blair too late for effective treatment after spending months and her savings on Dr. Conlon's fraudulent 'electro-radonic' machine, prompting Kildare and Gillespie to expose him.
